text:
[IRET.7.8] Token retraction propagates depth-first to
terminal nodes. At a terminal node, retraction removes
the corresponding activation from the agenda (if not yet
fired) and ends the activation, withdrawing whatever
justifications its firing recorded ([IRET.12.2]).

idris.name: iret_7_8__activation_live
idris.note: An activation is live while its token sits in its rule's table fired and unblocked; retracted, it has ended and its justifications are withdrawn. Blocking counts as ending, per [LLOG.11.5].

idris.name: iret_7_8__drop
idris.note: Drop departing tokens from the left memory, and their counts.

idris.name: iret_7_8__gone
idris.note: The same, read off the node.

idris.name: iret_7_8__gone_of
idris.note: What leaves downstream when tokens leave a node, by the flag, the join tests and the counts: every extension built from them, or, for a NOT node, those it had passed.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave
idris.note: Retraction propagates to the terminal, node by node; at the terminal the activation ends.

idris.name: iret_8_1__end
idris.note: At the terminal, retraction removes the activation, fired or not.

idris.name: iret_7_8__live_ext
idris.note: Whether a row's activation is live depends on the chains' activations alone.

idris.name: iret_7_8__through_gone
idris.note: What leaves a chain when tokens of its front leave, node by node.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_ordered
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION KEEPS THE ORDER: ending activations leaves a sublist.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_snd
idris.note: The unwave's terminal is the ending of exactly what leaves the chain.

idris.name: iret_7_8__activation_live_agree
idris.note: AN ACTIVATION IS LIVE ON THE NETWORK exactly when it is live on FireLoop: under the tables' agreement the terminal's fired activation of the row's identity is the table's fired, unblocked token of it.

idris.name: iret_7_8__activation_live_net
idris.note: An activation is live on the network while its rule's terminal holds an activation of its identity that has fired. The terminal holds unblocked matches only, so a match a `no` pattern now blocks has ended -- the absence-justified reading, as on FireLoop's side.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_shape
idris.note: Left-retraction keeps a chain's shape.

idris.name: iret_7_8__through_gone_prefix
idris.note: What leaves a chain when tokens leave its front extends one of them.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_evolves
idris.note: Token retraction to the terminal ends the activations of the tokens that left, and creates none.

idris.name: iret_7_8__gone_sub
idris.note: What leaves a node downstream when tokens of its front leave is something it passed on.

idris.name: iret_7_8__next_drop
idris.note: What a node passes on after tokens leave is what it passed on, less what left downstream.

idris.name: iret_7_8__unwave_consistent
idris.note: LEFT-RETRACTION KEEPS THE VIEW: when tokens of the front leave, every node drops them and their counts and the terminal loses exactly the matches they completed.

idris.name: iret_7_8__live_activation_facts
idris.note: A live activation's identity is a current match's ids, all live: its token is settled, so its facts are an enumerated tuple of live facts.

idris.name: iret_7_8__live_after_propagate
idris.note: THE TOKEN LEMMA. A live activation whose antecedent ids are all live in the new working memory is live after propagation: its token is kept, since its facts are a current match, with its `fired`, and nothing blocks it on a positive program. Why a retraction ends only the activations it should.

idris.name: iret_7_8__live_before_propagate
idris.note: THE CONVERSE OF THE TOKEN LEMMA. A live activation after propagation was live before: an added token is unfired, so the live token was kept, and a kept token keeps its identity and its `fired`. Why an activation is never resurrected by a propagation.

idris.name: iret_7_8__live_token_ok
idris.note: A token with the row's identity, fired and unblocked, passes the liveness test.

idris.name: Iret_7_8__tracked
idris.note: An activation tracked through a cascade: its reading holds, and it is live whenever its antecedents all are. The firing activation of a step is tracked this way.

idris.name: iret_7_8__tracked_retract
idris.note: A retraction and its propagation keep a tracked activation.
